title: The dual nature of alpha oscillations: Linking local rhythms to network function and dysfunction
title_zh: 阿尔法振荡的双重特性：连接局部节律与网络功能及功能障碍
abstract: Alpha oscillations are central to human brain function, yet their interpretation has traditionally focused on models of local inhibitory modulation. More recent findings, however, demonstrate a crucial role for alpha rhythms in network-level communication. This review integrates these perspectives, proposing that alpha rhythms regulate both the timing of local excitability and the alignment of excitability phases across the network, thereby enabling efficient information transmission. We summarize lifespan and clinical changes in alpha power, frequency, and connectivity, showing how these features reflect both the integrity of local oscillatory generators and the effectiveness of large-scale interactions. Coherence and travelling waves emerge as key markers linking these levels, capturing how excitability cycles are coordinated across the cortex. This integrated framework clarifies why alterations in alpha dynamics are sensitive indicators of dysfunction in aging, neurodegeneration, and brain injury. From a therapeutic perspective, traditional attempts to modulate alpha power alone may be insufficient, as they target local excitability without addressing network coordination. In contrast, coherence-based modulation may more effectively restore impaired communication dynamics. Neurofeedback studies demonstrating behavioral improvements following coherence training support this direction.
abstract_zh: 阿尔法振荡对人类大脑功能至关重要，但传统解释长期主要聚焦于局部抑制性调制模型。更近期的研究表明，阿尔法节律在网络级信息传递中也起关键作用。本文综述整合了这些视角，提出阿尔法节律既调控局部兴奋性的时序，也调节网络内兴奋性相位的一致对齐，从而实现高效的信息传输。我们汇总了阿尔法功率、频率和功能连接随年龄和疾病的变化，显示这些特征既反映局部振荡发生器的完整性，也反映大尺度交互的有效性。相干性（coherence）与传播波（traveling waves）成为连接这两个层级的关键指标，捕捉皮层内兴奋性周期如何跨皮层协调。该整合框架解释了为何阿尔法动力学的改变是老化、神经退行和脑损伤功能障碍的敏感指标。从治疗角度看，单纯调节阿尔法功率的传统尝试可能不足，因为这主要作用于局部兴奋性而未处理网络协调问题。相比之下，基于相干性的调控或更能有效恢复受损的信息传递动态。神经反馈研究显示，经相干性训练产生的行为改善支持了这一方向。
